import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_3.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold the 'attributes' column from each source
    attributes_list = []

    # Load each source file, extract 'attributes' column, drop NaNs, and collect
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Extract 'attributes' column, drop NaN values
        attrs = df['attributes'].dropna()
        attributes_list.append(attrs)

    # Concatenate all attributes into a single Series
    all_attributes = pd.concat(attributes_list, ignore_index=True)

    # Remove duplicates and reset index
    unique_attributes = all_attributes.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Create the target DataFrame with the required schema
    target_df = pd.DataFrame({'attributes': unique_attributes})

    # Save the result to the specified path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
